The Guardian clarified that the new law making the abduction of a cat or dog a specific criminal offence came into force only in England and Northern Ireland, not across the entire United Kingdom as originally stated.

* In the Q&A interview, Juliet Stevenson referred to her work with director Alex Lawther, not “Lowther”, and the family at the centre of Bend It Like Beckham is Sikh, not Muslim; additionally, the piece on Venetia Stanley misattributed her father’s conversion to Islam when it was her uncle, the third Baron Stanley, who converted.

***

Readers wishing to comment can write to the Readers’ Editor at the Observer, York Way, London N1 9GU, email observer.readers@observer.co.uk, or telephone 020 3353 4736.
